description: This file defines functions to load various plugin provider contract registries for speech, media understanding, realtime voice, transcription, image, and video generation, specifically for testing with Vitest. It imports external modules, defines types, and implements registry loading functions that utilize dynamic imports and runtime registry loading.

methods.name: buildVitestCapabilityAliasMap
methods.description: Builds a map of module path aliases for Vitest testing environment, including shims and SDK paths.

methods.name: resolveNamedBuilder
methods.description: Resolves a named builder function from a module export based on a pattern.

methods.name: resolveNamedValues
methods.description: Resolves multiple named values from a module export matching a pattern and type guard.

methods.name: resolveTestApiModuleRecords
methods.description: Filters plugin manifests to those with 'bundled' origin and unresolved plugin IDs.

methods.name: createVitestCapabilityLoader
methods.description: Creates a Jiti loader configured with alias map for Vitest testing.

methods.name: isMediaUnderstandingProvider
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a MediaUnderstandingProviderPlugin.

methods.name: loadVitestSpeechProviderContractRegistry
methods.description: Loads speech provider contracts for Vitest testing, combining manifest and runtime registry data.

methods.name: loadVitestMediaUnderstandingProviderContractRegistry
methods.description: Loads media understanding provider contracts for Vitest testing, combining manifest and runtime registry data.

methods.name: loadVitestRealtimeVoiceProviderContractRegistry
methods.description: Loads realtime voice provider contracts for Vitest testing, combining manifest and runtime registry data.

methods.name: loadVitestRealtimeTranscriptionProviderContractRegistry
methods.description: Loads realtime transcription provider contracts for Vitest testing, combining manifest and runtime registry data.

methods.name: loadVitestImageGenerationProviderContractRegistry
methods.description: Loads image generation provider contracts for Vitest testing, combining manifest and runtime registry data.

methods.name: loadVitestVideoGenerationProviderContractRegistry
methods.description: Loads video generation provider contracts for Vitest testing, combining manifest and runtime registry data.
